name: session-chats
description: A side pane that draws your Claude Code sessions as a graph: one node per session, one arrow per conversation (SendMessage), dashed until the other side answers. The record is kept on disk, so it survives after the sessions close; select a session to see its links and last messages, and Open resumes it in a new terminal (claude --resume in its own folder).

terminal.title: Open in
terminal.description: Where Open resumes a session: auto (a tmux window inside tmux, else macOS Terminal), Terminal, iTerm, tmux, or copy (only copy the command)

keepDays.title: Keep history (days)
keepDays.description: Forget a session's log once it has not been written for this many days

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (40-140)
